newsitem.title: USA: NYC Muni Water revs rated AAA by Fitch.
newsitem.headline: NYC Muni Water revs rated AAA by Fitch.

text.p: New York City Municipal Water Finance Authority's $104,900,000 water and sewer system refunded revenue bonds, fiscal 1992 series C and $19,310,000 fiscal 1993 series B are rated "AAA" by Fitch Investors Service.

The "AAA" rating reflects the fact the refunded bonds are secured by an irrevocable escrow agreement with United States Trust Company of New York and composed of direct, non-callable obligations of the U.S. government.

On Oct. 29, 1996, the authority issued $365,125,000 of water and sewer system revenue bonds, fiscal 1997 series A for the purpose, among other things, of refunding portions of the fiscal 1992 series C and fiscal 1993 series B issues. The $104,900,000 1992 series C refunded bonds are a portion of $120,000,000 term bonds, subject to sinking fund redemption payments, originally scheduled to mature on June 15, 2021. These bonds are being advance refunded to call on June 15, 1997 at a redemption premium of 101.5%. The $19,310,000 series B refunded bonds are term bonds, subject to sinking fund redemption payments, originally scheduled to mature on June 15, 2020. These bonds are being advance refunded to call on June 15, 2002 at a redemption premium of 101%.

Ernst & Young LLP., has mathematically verified that the anticipated receipts from the U.S. government obligations, without regard to reinvestment earnings from a forward supply contract between Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce and the U.S. Trust Company of New York, will be sufficient to pay, when due, the principal, interest and early redemption requirements of the refunded bonds.
